en: A vintage, sepia-toned hand-colored postcard showing a one-story commercial building called the Bank Block with striped awnings, small trees along the sidewalk, and several people standing in front. There is an unpaved street with trolley or rail tracks and a horse-drawn vehicle to the left. The card has printed captions in red along the bottom and left/right margins and a red number in the lower right corner.
